investigation_notes.Scriptblock: Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data' -Destination C:\ProgramData\chrome_cache.db -Force; Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*.default-release\logins.json' -Destination C:\ProgramData\ff_cache.json -Force
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell script executed on HR-SRV-02 by user k.tamm copied Chrome and Firefox credential stores from all user profiles into C:\ProgramData, which matches credential-harvesting behavior. No physical file path or process hash was provided, so this assessment is based on the in-memory scriptblock and host context; no historical events or similar alerts were found to indicate benign activity. No VirusTotal or external IP reputation data is available or applicable. Given the sensitive nature of the files accessed, the execution context on a server, and lack of benign correlation, this is assessed as High Priority.
